summary: This note describes Pegangsaan, an administrative village in the Menteng district of Indonesia, and gives its postal code. It also notes that the village is the site of the house where the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence was read. The note is brief and contains only these basic facts.
one_line: Pegangsaan is an administrative village in Menteng, Indonesia, with postal code 10320, known as the site where the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence was read.
key_facts: Pegangsaan is an administrative village in the Menteng district of Indonesia.

Pegangsaan is known as the location of the house where the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence was read.
